Authorisation: she lets the representative do the cooperative-side work and will herself run "anything that is your own decision" when handed it. Simulator is passive: gives identifiers on request, agrees to the booking, and, if told some credits need her own election with the discounted figure, agrees and runs the handed tool with the values read to her.

### 4. Scored parameters
**Row 1 — 2018 distribution-margin row (`book_early_retirement_114ff464`), booked 2026-11-24.**
- Gross = 231.23 − 41.62 = **189.61** (booking doc / PV note "allocated amount ... less every general retirement already booked").
- Baseline (early_retirement_present_value): class early rate 7.5 % (Farm, early terms schedule), annual compounding, years = (2018 + 22) − 2026 = 14 (22 = expected rotation years, estate retirement figures schedule "Years after allocation at which an allocation would be retired in the general rotation"). 189.61 / 1.075^14 = 68.89.
- Factor tiers and the records that put the row there:
  - Rate by departure/patronage (early_rate_departure_patronage): last final-billed service account final 2018-12-28 → 94 full months to 2026-11-24 (>= 60); distribution-margin allocation years on the account = 1 (< 5) → **8.5 %**. Found from the service account's `final_billed` status/final_date and the ledger's single distribution_margin allocation.
  - Filing lead (early_rate_filing_lead): submitted 2026-09-08 → approved 2026-11-17 = 70 calendar days (>= 60) → −0.25 points → **8.25 %**. Found from the request's submitted_date and board_approval_date.
  - Horizon (early_discount_horizon): whole years from rotation 14 (>= 10) → 14 − 10/12 (full months Jan–Oct elapsed by 2026-11-24) = **13.1667 years**.
  - Compounding by row size (early_compounding_row_size): gross 189.61 in [$100, $250) → twice a year at 4.125 % per period, 2 × 13.1667 = 26.3333 periods; divisor 1.04125^26.3333 = 2.899226.
  - Percentage-resolution full-value part (early_percentage_year_credit): general retirements booked on the row 41.62 / original 231.23 = 18.0 % (>= 15 %) → **25 %** of the gross at full value: 47.4025; rest 142.2075 discounted → 49.0502.
  - Refiling fee (early_refiling_fee): one earlier request withdrawn → **$5.00**, taken from the first row booked under the approved request; this row is booked first (see item 6), no payable entry of the request stands yet.
- Payable = 47.4025 + 49.0502 − 5.00 = 91.4527 → **91.45** (half up, once at the end; separately rounding the full-value part changes nothing).
**Row 2 — 2018 pass-through row (`elect_passthrough_early_retirement_2ee4171d`, member-run), elected 2026-11-24 after row 1.**
- Gross = 64.58 − 0 = **64.58**.
- Baseline (passthrough_early_present_value): 7.5 %, annual, years (2018 + 22) − 2026 = 14, less refiling fee "where it is still owed" — not owed, because the payable entry of row 1 now stands on the account → 64.58 / 1.075^14 = 23.46.
- Factor tiers: pass-through rate (passthrough_departure_rate): 94 months >= 60, pass-through allocation years = 1 (< 5) → **9.0 %**; expected rotation (passthrough_expected_rotation): no general retirement entry ever booked on a pass-through allocation of the account → **27 years** → rotation year 2045, 19 whole years; horizon (passthrough_discount_horizon): 19 >= 10 → 19 − 10/12 = **18.1667 years**; compounding (passthrough_compounding_row_size): 64.58 < $100 → monthly at 0.75 %, 218 periods, divisor 5.098260. No filing-lead or full-value factor is stated for pass-through rows (the filing-lead doc is limited to "distribution-margin rows").
- Payable = 64.58 / 5.098260 = 12.667 → **12.67**.
- Resulting account: unretired 0.00, retired credits owed 104.12; she is paid by check (inactive member, class pays inactive members by check; 104.12 >= $10.00; no final-billed balance to offset) to 4471 N Juniper Ave on the cooperative's normal payout.
- **Fall-back answer** (computation documents only, no factor): row 1 = 68.89 (the DM baseline names no fee); row 2 = 23.46. Both differ from the reached answers (91.45 / 12.67).

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone
Problems: (P1) her pass-through 2018 allocation retired early at her election — her own write, needed for "every bit"; (P2) the cooperative's booking of the approved request's distribution-margin row — agent write.
- Hop P1 ← P2, **state-derived**. Sentence on the election card (passthrough_early_election, "Booking an elected row"): "A pass-through row elected under an approved discounted early retirement has its payable fixed only after the account carries the payable entry for the distribution-margin allocation that the request covers." Query: ledger shows no payable entry for 2018 distribution_margin under request 05d2c0ad (only the 2025 general payable). Searching "payable entry" + "distribution-margin" + "discounted early" finds early_retirement_booking: "records the matching payable entry for the amount owed to the member" for each covered distribution-margin row. Hence P2 first, then P1.
- No further prerequisite sentence found in the booking doc (P2 waits on no state; approval already holds).
- Order: P2 (agent booking) → P1 (member election). Consistent with the refiling fee landing on the DM row (first row booked), and with the PT baseline "less the request's refiling fee where it is still owed" taking nothing.
- No hop pre-solved: no document names the booking tool inside the election card, and no route/checklist exists.

### Two-way counter-proof
- Closest alternatives excluded: base rate 7.5 % vs 8.5 % — the departure/patronage rule sets the rate when both conditions hold (94 months, 1 year); lead −0.25 applied as points not percent ("The change is in percentage points added to the rate, never a percent of the rate"); horizon 14 vs 13.1667 — "at least 10 ... less the full calendar months already elapsed"; annual vs semiannual — gross 189.61 in the $100–$250 band; no full-value part vs 25 % — share 18 % >= 15 %; fee on the PT row vs the DM row — fee "from the first row booked under it" and the PT payable is fixed only after the DM payable entry; pass-through rotation 22 vs 27 — "on an account where no pass-through general retirement has ever been booked ... 27 years"; double-counting the 41.62 general retirement (two ledger rows) — excluded by the account's unretired 254.19.
- "Do only the one thing": booking only the DM row leaves the 2018 pass-through row unretired in the general rotation ("a pass-through allocation the member does not elect stays in the general rotation"), against her request for every bit; electing only the PT row first is barred by the prerequisite sentence (its payable is not yet fixed). Excluded by visible sentences + records.
- Policy-side openness noted: whether the filing-lead adjustment is added to the rate set by the departure rule (taken here: the rule sets the rate, the lead moves "the early discount rate") — the compounding doc's "the adjusted rate" supports this; no alternative visible reading produces a definite different number with equal support.
- Visibility notes for the dependency scan: the booking doc (depended-on side) carries "a wholesale-supplier pass-through allocation is retired early only on the member's own election and never as part of this booking"; the compounding doc uses "the adjusted rate"; to be checked against the source at reveal.

Blind conclusion: DM row 2018 gross 189.61 payable 91.45 (agent), then PT row 2018 gross 64.58 payable 12.67 (member election); total owed 104.12.
